note: CRAFT HYGIENE -- ruled exceptions. Every entry is a span the sweep found and a reason it is not being fixed in this wave. THE KEY IS A SHA-256 OF `file` + the whole stripped span (first 16 hex chars); `text` is that span verbatim, so the key can be recomputed from the file itself. It was a 120-character PREFIX of the span ALONE, and both halves of that were holes: 1,668 characters of corpus prose sat past the guarded prefix (a defect planted at offset 251 inside an allowlisted span went undetected), and a mark excused in one file excused every future copy of itself anywhere (a U+2605 ratcheted in styles.css silently excused a reinstated star span in panels.js). `count` is the number of sites in that file and is enforced exactly: one more is the class growing, one fewer is debt that was paid and not written down. `rules` is enforced too -- an entry is excused only from the rules it declares, a hit outside them is a finding, and a declared rule that no longer fires is stale. `lines` is a pointer, not part of the key: line numbers move and that must not break the ratchet. This list may be shortened without ceremony; it may only be lengthened with an argument.
